the relationship between commitment-based HR practices, organizational social capital, organizational learning capability with organizational performance.

the relationship between commitment-based HR practices, organizational social capital, organizational learning capability on organizational performance of Japanese multinational corporations in Malaysia.

commitment based HRM practices and organizational social capital are the most important predictors for organizational performance of Japanese multinational corporations in Malaysia.
commitment based HR policies and practices are essential in promoting the organizational social capital and ultimately organizational performance.

commitment based HR policies and practices are important for the organization's performance and social capital.

the commitment based HR practices in the organization would lead to the development of organizational social capital and in turn would enhance the organizational performance of the organization.

the HR practitioners need to be more committed to the organization and its people.
